text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten pretty good at putting it on by myself, haven't I?
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Osaka Hai, Fine Motion
was in high spirits as usual.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I came to say hello before the race!
Let's have a great day out there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward
to running with you, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward... to this as well.
Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-chan,
you really are such a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it seems she's gotten remarkably stronger
lately... I can't let my guard down!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's stay sharp
and have some fun♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words were the same as always. But...
it sounded as though she were trying to convince herself.
choice_data_list: In the race, forget everything and just run.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't do that.
I am myself, Fine Motion, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Much less... wishing that I could forget it... I mustn't.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Let's give it all we've got♪
—With a smile until the very last step!
